bio: Angila Vaccaro was born about 1639 at San Mango di Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy. She died there on 8 January 1712, the date entered for her burial in the San Mango parish register.
funFacts: The 1712 burial register is exceptional: 129 burials that year, 53 of them in December, against a normal 10-30 a year. Several of John's ancestors died in that wave.
